parole.significato: Oriya, Odia (an Indo-Aryan language spoken in India)
palanquin (Asian litters or sedan chairs, especially enclosed palanquins)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Odia ପାଲଙ୍କି (pālaṅki, “litter”), from Sanskrit पल्यङ्क (palyaṅka), variant of पर्यङ्क (paryaṅka, “bed, couch, litter”) of uncertain origin.
